carpet.linePrev: In this belly of a whale
carpet.line: Its ribs our ceiling beams, its guts our carpeting
carpet.lineNext: I guess we have some time to kill
stanza: We are two mariners, our ships' sole survivors
In this belly of a whale
Its ribs our ceiling beams, its guts our carpeting
I guess we have some time to kill
You may not remember me, I was a child of three
And you, a lad of eighteen
But I remember you, and I will relate to you
At the time you were a rake and a roustabout
Spending all your money on the whores and hounds

carpet.linePrev: It took hours and hours to scrub it out
carpet.lineNext: I took my mop and my bucket
stanza: I remember it was that Wednesday
Oh, when it rained and it rained
They traipsed mud all over the house
It took hours and hours to scrub it out
I took my mop and my bucket
And I cleaned and I cleaned the kitchen floor
